subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable-container install/trust path for official external channel plugins, and which source of truth should confer trusted state access?
rationale: The current supported installer ties package payload and install provenance to the active state directory, while the proposed deployment model needs that provenance to survive a mounted mutable state directory without turning raw load paths into trusted code.

options.title: Approve immutable official plugin root
options.body: Add a narrow official-plugin package/provenance root for image builds, verified against install records, resolved paths, and official catalog identity, while keeping raw load paths untrusted.

options.title: Keep mounted-state installer only
options.body: Document that trusted external channel plugins must be installed into the mounted OpenClaw state directory and close this deployment model as unsupported.

options.title: Broaden allowlist or load-path trust
options.body: Let operator-configured ids or load paths grant keyed-state access, accepting a weaker provenance boundary for self-hosted convenience.

recommendation.title: Approve immutable official plugin root
recommendation.body: Add a narrow official-plugin package/provenance root for image builds, verified against install records, resolved paths, and official catalog identity, while keeping raw load paths untrusted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and already stated the intended trust boundary in the thread, making them the best available owner for the security/product choice.
